carouselA.title: Controlled Company, Controlled Story: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: Founder voting or board control can shape who appoints leaders and approves major corporate acts, but it cannot guarantee truthful archives, good design, worker voice, or permanent cultural legitimacy.

frames.caption: 01 · VOTE — What does the vote actually reach?. Record security class, votes per share, ownership date, agreements, transfer limits, quorum, reserved matters, and the exact filing. Do not convert disclosed voting power into a claim about every creative decision.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what does the vote actually reach? within Controlled Company, Controlled Story.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · BOARD — Who directs the corporation?. For a Delaware corporation, inspect certificate, bylaws, board composition, committee and delegation records with §141. Founder status alone is not a board rule.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who directs the corporation? within Controlled Company, Controlled Story.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · STORY — Which systems shape public memory?. Map archive access, approval language, publicity, account control, historian or curator independence, contributor correction, and disputed records separately from corporate votes.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping which systems shape public memory? within Controlled Company, Controlled Story.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · CONSTRAINT — Who can challenge the controller?. Identify independent directors, contractual rights, worker and collaborator channels, law, fiduciary review, press scrutiny, archive policy, and correction routes without assuming any is effective in a particular company.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who can challenge the controller? within Controlled Company, Controlled Story.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: Founder control can protect experimentation and continuity; it can also preserve error and concentrate the power to describe other people’s labor. Control is neither virtue nor vice without facts, process, dissent, and outcome.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for Controlled Company, Controlled Story.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery

frames.caption: Attach one exact governing record to every formal power claim.
